title: 有馬記念の後に・磨斧作針

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Classic Triple Crown under her belt and an impressive showing in the Arima Kinen, Symboli Rudolf sets her sights on the shield of the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On returning to the waiting room, she is greeted by Air Groove, but the vice-president seems exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that she is the reason Air Groove has been running herself ragged, Symboli Rudolf resolves not to skimp on her presidential duties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the year comes to an end, it seems that the pair's desire to lighten one another's burdens is preventing them from seeing eye to eye.
